punch_items.evidence: pathminer/models/board.py (BoardSource Protocol + domain dataclasses), pathminer/kicad/board.py (parse_board), pathminer/kicad/source.py (FileBoardSource) added. Done-when clause ('the same analysis accepts either adapter without branching') demonstrated: FileBoardSource satisfies the runtime_checkable BoardSource Protocol (isinstance(source, BoardSource) asserted). tests/test_board_source.py: 48 passed (protocol conformance, stable REF.PAD lookup, terminal alias collapsing, named drift diagnostics, real IP5385-board regression). Full suite 372 passed, 0 regressions. Import-boundary guard 48/48 passed.

FileBoardSource.check_drift()/resolve() resolve a REF.PAD against the current board and compare the recorded net name, raising named PadNotFoundError (broken identity) or NetDriftError (net renamed). TestDriftDiagnostics and test_rerouted_board_same_ref_pad_still_resolves_geometry in tests/test_board_source.py demonstrate 'a rerouted board resolves the same paths or produces a named drift error' at the BoardSource layer. Path persistence/schema and GUI/CLI drift policy remain open for a later session.

apis_changed: pathminer.models.board: Point, Net, Track, Via, Pad, TerminalAlias, Terminal, Pour, PadDrift (frozen dataclasses); ref_pad_name(); BoardSourceError, PadNotFoundError, NetDriftError; BoardSource (runtime_checkable Protocol) — all new public surface
pathminer.kicad.board: ParsedBoard (internal aggregate), parse_board(path) -> ParsedBoard — new public surface
pathminer.kicad.source: FileBoardSource(path) implementing BoardSource, plus .path and .notes (non-protocol diagnostics) — new public surface
compatibility_consequences: No existing API modified; all new surface is additive
tools/pcb_trace_resistance.py is unchanged; monolith and the new BoardSource stack coexist
Session 07 (network/builders, ARCH-004) should consume boards only through the BoardSource protocol, not by re-parsing .kicad_pcb directly
A future LiveKiCadBoardSource must satisfy pathminer.models.board.BoardSource to be a drop-in with FileBoardSource

tests.result: 372 passed in 1.93s (full post-change suite: 324 pre-existing + 48 new; 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped)

6 passed (IP5385 real-board parity: 4-layer non-estimated stackup; C53.1 and U9.S REF.PAD resolve; U9.S collapses 3 physical pads into 2 aliases; unknown REF.PAD raises PadNotFoundError; pours present; net_name(3) == 'GNDREF')

decisions: Owned scope split as models=pure BoardSource protocol/domain contracts, kicad/board.py=parser, kicad/source.py=FileBoardSource; kicad imports models (only kicad.stackup, a leaf module, flows the other way), verified acyclic and ARCH-002-compliant by running tests/test_import_boundaries.py unchanged

Pour carries only raw fill polygons; v0.13's principal-axis/aspect/contains() pour analysis is left for the ARCH-004/Session 07 network-builder layer, which will consume Pour.fills via pathminer.core.geometry directly
Graph-building (build_graph, ladder/mesh) intentionally not extracted; only BoardNets's geometry-harvesting half moved, per the ARCH-004/Session 07 boundary in the refactor plan

pad() indexes REF.PAD board-wide (not per net) since a REF.PAD name is assumed unique per component; terminals(net) still recomputes per net exactly as v0.13 did, including dedupe=False raw-row behavior
resolve()/check_drift() raise PadNotFoundError for a missing pad (broken identity) rather than reporting it as drift; only a resolved pad with a changed net name is drift (NetDriftError)

Added an estimated-stackup fallback (manual_stackup()) inside parse_board when a board has no (stackup) block, per project specification S8.2; this is new coverage for BoardSource.stackup, not a change to pathminer.kicad.stackup itself
Class-scoped pytest fixtures use @classmethod, matching the Session 05 convention, to avoid the pytest 10 deprecation warning
Fixture files are committed under tests/fixtures/kicad/ (unlike Session 05's tmp_path-only synthetic content) because this session's owned scope explicitly lists that directory
assumptions: pathminer/models/__init__.py's docstring ('imports core and kicad... converts board geometry into a ResistorNetwork') describes the future Session 07 builder modules, not board.py, and is not contradicted by models/board.py importing only kicad.stackup

pathminer/kicad/__init__.py's docstring ('Provides the BoardSource protocol and FileBoardSource implementation') is read as a package-level responsibility satisfied jointly by kicad/board.py and kicad/source.py, with the protocol's canonical definition in models/board.py
Pads sharing one REF.PAD name are assumed to share one net; confirmed on both synthetic fixtures and the IP5385 board's U9.S (3 pads, all net 94)

No committed .kicad_pcb fixture contained an (arc ...) block to copy verbatim (confirmed: the IP5385 board has none), so the arc block in board_min.kicad_pcb was hand-constructed from the parser's expected shape and verified to produce a true arc length greater than the chord
